q: How should a tile maker count pallets, cartons and stretch film?
title: Tile makers: pallets and packaging
short: Pallets, cartons, corner boards and stretch film you buy are purchased goods, Scope 3 category 1. Count them by unit or kg from invoices with a factor for each, and include them per square metre if a buyer wants a delivered product figure.
audience: Ceramic and vitrified tile makers packing for domestic and export markets

p: Wooden or plastic pallets by unit and weight.
Stretch film and straps by kg.
If pallets come back and are reused, spread each pallet's figure over its trips and record the trip count you assumed.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
